verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਹੋਮ ਜਗਿ ਭੋਗ ਨਈਬੇਦ ਪੂਜਾਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh ek mek rom na pujas koT hom jag bhog nieebedh poojaachaar hai ||

en.bdb: No one, not even millions of offerings to the fire, celestial feasts, offerings to the gods and other forms of worship, rites and rituals can reach even a hair of a Sikh who has become one with his True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧੋ ਜਲ ਤਲ ਸੰਜਮਾਦਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jog dhiaan giaan adhiaatam ridh sidh nidho jal tal sa(n)jamaadh anik prakaar hai ||

en.bdb: Many forms of Yogas contemplations, exercises to control the body and other disciplines of Yoga, miraculous powers and other forms of obstinate worships cannot reach to match a hair of a Guru's Sikh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਉ ਸਾਅੰਗੀਤ ਸੁਰਸਰਿ ਦੇਵ ਸਬਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: si(n)mirat puraan bedh saasatr aau saa(n)geet surasar dhev sabal maiaa bisathaar hai ||

en.bdb: All the Simritis, Vedas, Purans, other scriptures, music, rivers like Ganges, abodes of gods and expanse of mammon in the entire Universe can reach the praise of a hair of a Guru's Sikh who has become one with the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੧੯੨॥
verses.translit_en: koTin koTaan sikh sa(n)gat asa(n)kh jaa kai sree gur charan net net namasakaar hai ||192||

en.bdb: Countless are the congregations of such Sikhs of the Guru. Such a True Guru is beyond count. He is infinite. We salute at His holy feet again and again. (192)
